uric_acid_and_heart_failure.summary: Multiple references discuss the relationship between serum uric acid / hyperuricemia and heart failure, including pathophysiology, risk association, and treatment trials of uric acid-lowering therapies in heart failure patients.

uric_acid_lowering_treatments.summary: Studies and trials of uric acid–lowering agents (allopurinol, febuxostat, oxypurinol, benzbromarone) and their cardiovascular safety or effects in patients with gout or heart failure are cited.

xanthine_oxidase_inhibition.summary: Effects of xanthine oxidase inhibition in hyperuricemic heart failure patients are reported, including a named trial (EXACT-HF).

colchicine_in_cardiac_disease.summary: Systematic review/meta-analysis and experimental data addressing colchicine effects in cardiac disease (benefit/risk) are cited.

nonsteroidal_antiinflammatory_drugs_safe.summary: Reference to safety assessment of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) from a project consortium.
